verdict: Organic activity holding this period; paid channels and CRM build are the priority.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, every inbound action — 402 total Google Business Profile interactions including 26 calls, 262 direction requests, and 114 web clicks — came through organic search alone, with no paid advertising running. Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision both saw GBP engagement drop sharply in the last week (down 61% and 64% respectively), while Advance Grinding moved in the opposite direction, growing 19% week over week. The late-week softening at two locations aligns with a broader organic search dip and is being addressed as part of an SEO and site reindexing effort with a fix submitted by August 31. CRM setup milestones from July remain open and are the primary blocker to launching outreach sequences and paid campaigns; those are the critical path items being moved this week.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
week-over-week drop in GBP engagement at O'Hare Precision, the sharpest single-location decline this period
week-over-week GBP growth at Advance Grinding, the one location trending in the right direction

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining at two of three locations in the most recent week, compounded by no paid activity generating leads across any location.
watch_item.fix: An SEO root-cause fix is being submitted by August 31, contact lists are being pulled this week to unblock outreach sequences, and CRM setup is being escalated to clear the July milestones still outstanding.
